# Sbarter Token Vesting Program supplementary proof

## Program and token info

This program, [`7db6vHi6uoKvFA5zP7YkadBQmnThhYJYJ2ova2S16JpJ`](https://explorer.solana.com/address/7db6vHi6uoKvFA5zP7YkadBQmnThhYJYJ2ova2S16JpJ/program-multisig), is a custom
vesting program for the Sbarter token (SBT), controlled by the Association
Sbarter Multi-sig (Squads), configured to have no single point of failure.

It controls minting the one final supply of 25 billion SBTs to a Master PDA vault,
from which it is distributed to 5 categories of Team/Investors, and 3
functional allocation categories: Marketing, Reserve, and Liquidity.
The process happens strictly according to the Sbarter Tokenomics Whitepaper:
token supply is initially locked in a single program-controlled account, and is
gradually distributed to 8 program-controlled Category PDA accounts on a 30-day
basis, and from there -- to team, investors, and liquidity pools.

Therefore, top holder wallets are not owners of the unlocked team supply; they
are temporary vaults.

## Audits & Security

This vesting program operates according to the Sbarter Tokenomics Whitepaper: https://sbarter.com/white-paper

The codebase and the project were verified by CertiK: https://skynet.certik.com/projects/sbarter

The deployed program passes the Verified Build check: https://explorer.solana.com/address/7db6vHi6uoKvFA5zP7YkadBQmnThhYJYJ2ova2S16JpJ/verified-build

The program upgrade authority is owned by the Association Sbarter Multi-sig: https://app.squads.so/squads/HUp2467gcy1qBXNjFeaY4VpFyTMUgStMJQTmuFbyCnTx/developer/programs/7db6vHi6uoKvFA5zP7YkadBQmnThhYJYJ2ova2S16JpJ

The program IDL is public and can be viewed here: [../idl/master_token_program.json](../idl/master_token_program.json)

All setup of the [TGE event](https://explorer.solana.com/tx/4YWxWWqjpYvwvLrk4Yiy1miPTkRVToffud2sd9kpb5VKDosAPWYjtXbfmNUjFdTXT2SpViBxNDUxoQCYB54yTdem) that happened on
